name: Requests routed to the right worker
purpose: Each request goes to the worker category the seat that owns that kind of request measures on (web search, Science, file editing, or none).
record: Eighty-one requests taken from other seats' own case sets (evaluation/request_planning/build_cases.py): twenty web-search questions, twenty literature questions, twenty coding goals, twenty requests that need no context and one two-step request. One number: the share routed to the right worker.
disadvantages: The labels are the seat each request came from, not a person's judgment of the best worker; a request that needs several workers is one case.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run request_planning --impl cue_router; esoi run request_planning --impl one_piece
